scenes.text: Only add coefficients of like terms. Constants combine with constants, and x-terms with x-terms.
Simplify 5x plus 5x plus 7 minus 8. The answer is 10x minus 1. Combine x-terms (5 plus 5)x and constants 7 minus 8.
A learner in a craft workshop combines 8x plus 6 plus 4x minus 7. Which simplified expression is correct? Pause to choose and explain.
A learner in a craft workshop combines 8x plus 6 plus 4x minus 7. Which simplified expression is correct? The answer is 12x minus 1. Combine x-terms (8 plus 4)x and constants 6 minus 7.
